The same method can be zero-shot for one dataset and true zero-shot for another one. ZESHEL Logeswaran et al. ( 2019 ) is a benchmark for evaluating entity linking methods in a zero-shot setting, built with documents from Wikia 5 5 5 https://www.wikia.com/ , a Wikipedia-like Web site for specific subjects such as fictional universes or sports. ZESHEL consists of 8 Wikia domains for training, 4 for validation, and 4 for testing. The test has a total of 10,000 mentions. For each mention, the dataset provides 64 candidates retrieved by BM25. Entities correspond to Wikia pages, where the entity name is the title of the page and the entity description is its content. The BM25-based candidate retrieval has a top-64 recall of 68% on the test set. Following previous work Logeswaran et al. ( 2019 ); Xu et al. ( 2023 ); Li et al.
